ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 0.15:0.85 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area mapped with discrete, high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs (circular rings and focal spots) ranging from 5 to 30 pixels in diameter, scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1.2 relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge boundary; multiple distinct peaks and jagged valleys with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 10 to 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the interior trailing edges transitioning to a sharp upward-sloping convex trajectory toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of numerous high-contrast white circular and elliptical rings (approx. 10-25 pixels diameter) distributed globally, with higher clustering in the medial and basal regions of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear marks (scratches) oriented horizontally and diagonally, most notably in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and likely trauma-induced serration of the trailing edges; presence of brownish-orange biological material or debris attached to the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The exceptionally high density and clarity of discrete circular white 'donut' scars against the black pigmentation creates a unique visual constellation pattern.
